js: (async()=>{const load=s=>new Promise(r=>{const i=new Image();i.onload=()=>r(i);i.src=s;});const stat=async(a,b)=>{const[A,B]=await Promise.all([load(a),load(b)]);const W=A.width,H=A.height;const ca=document.createElement('canvas'),cb=document.createElement('canvas');ca.width=cb.width=W;ca.height=cb.height=H;const ga=ca.getContext('2d'),gb=cb.getContext('2d');ga.drawImage(A,0,0);gb.drawImage(B,0,0);const da=ga.getImageData(0,0,W,H).data,db=gb.getImageData(0,0,W,H).data;let sA=0,sB=0,sD=0,sM=0,nM=0,mx=0;const b0=(H*0.35)|0,b1=(H*0.8)|0;for(let y=0;y<H;y++)for(let x=0;x<W;x++){const i=(y*W+x)*4;const la=0.2126*da[i]+0.7152*da[i+1]+0.0722*da[i+2];const lb=0.2126*db[i]+0.7152*db[i+1]+0.0722*db[i+2];sA+=la;sB+=lb;const d=Math.abs(la-lb);sD+=d;if(d>mx)mx=d;if(y>=b0&&y<b1){sM+=d;nM++;}}const n=W*H;return{img:[W,H],meanOn:+(sA/n).toFixed(2),meanOff:+(sB/n).toFixed(2),meanAbsDiff:+(sD/n).toFixed(2),midBandDiff:+(sM/nM).toFixed(2),maxDiff:mx|0};};return{far:await stat('shots/s1-far-on.png','shots/s2-far-off.png'),close:await stat('shots/s3-close-on.png','shots/s4-close-off.png')};})()
